name: Luolai Lifestyle Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Luolai Lifestyle Technology Co., Ltd. produces and sells home textiles and bedding, shoes, and hats in China. It offers textiles, clothing, footwear, knitwear, arts and crafts; the import and export of goods and technology; brand management, general trading, information consulting, and investment and management services; the production and sale of furniture, daily necessities, and home furnishings. The company was formerly known as Luolai Home Textile Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Luolai Lifestyle Technology Co., Ltd. in December 2015. Luolai Lifestyle Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is based in Shanghai, China.
